newsitem.title: USA: Illinois unemployment stays at 4.4 pct in June.
newsitem.headline: Illinois unemployment stays at 4.4 pct in June.

text.p: Illinois' seasonally adjusted unemployment rate remained at 4.4 percent in June and the state reported a ninth-consecutive month of record employment, the department of employment security reported Tuesday.
"Throughout the first half of 1997, Illinois has continued a trend of declining unemployment and steady job growth," department Director Lynn Doherty said in a statement.
The seasonally adjusted rate reflected a drop from the 5.3 percent reported in June 1996 and remained well below the national rate of 5 percent for the month, the department reported.
Numerous sectors reported hiring increases over the past year led by the services sector and transportation sector, the department reported.
